_comment: THE BASELINE MANIFEST — what resolves when env.ARM_MANIFEST is absent.
It is byte-for-byte today's worker-v2 behaviour. This is what makes the seam REVERSIBLE:
survey-qa-v2 carries no ARM_MANIFEST, resolves to this, and does not change.
It is NOT an arm. verify.mjs refuses to treat it as one (armId is not in ARMS), so it
can never be scored, compared, or counted as a condition.
label: worker-v2 as deployed — not an experimental condition
